description: This file contains a generic implementation of hash-based key-value mappings, including functions for hashing strings and memory blocks, handling hash map operations such as initialization, insertion, removal, rehashing, and iteration, specifically tailored for a hashmap data structure in C.

methods.name: unsigned int strhash(const char * str)
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a string using the FNV-1a hash algorithm.

methods.name: unsigned int strihash(const char * str)
methods.description: Computes a case-insensitive hash value for a string.

methods.name: unsigned int memhash(const void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a memory chunk.

methods.name: unsigned int memihash(const void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes a case-insensitive hash for a memory chunk.

methods.name: unsigned int memihash_cont(unsigned int hash_seed,const void * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Incorporates additional data into an existing memihash value.

methods.name: void hashmap_init(struct hashmap * map,hashmap_cmp_fn equals_function,const void * cmpfn_data,size_t initial_size)
methods.description: Initializes a hashmap with a specified comparison function and size.

methods.name: void hashmap_add(struct hashmap * map,struct hashmap_entry * entry)
methods.description: Adds an entry to the hashmap.

methods.name: struct:hashmap_entry * hashmap_remove(struct hashmap * map,const struct hashmap_entry * key,const void * keydata)
methods.description: Removes an entry from the hashmap based on key.

methods.name: struct:hashmap_entry * hashmap_get(const struct hashmap * map,const struct hashmap_entry * key,const void * keydata)
methods.description: Retrieves an entry from the hashmap matching the key.

methods.name: struct:hashmap_entry * hashmap_get_next(const struct hashmap * map,const struct hashmap_entry * entry)
methods.description: Gets the next entry in the hashmap iteration.

methods.name: void hashmap_iter_init(struct hashmap * map,struct hashmap_iter * iter)
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for traversing the hashmap.

methods.name: struct:hashmap_entry * hashmap_iter_next(struct hashmap_iter * iter)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next entry.

methods.name: const void * memintern(const void * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Implements string interning using a static hashmap for memory optimization.
